title: Kentucky State University, sociology and Whitney Young
summary: He picked sociology at random at 17 or 18, and helped Whitney Young with science in the dormitory.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: How did you happen to decide to major in sociology?

Well, I had no idea what I wanted to major in. But going into the registrar's office, and just write down something. I should have had some advice, but I just said sociology because it seemed popular.
I must have been nuts. 17, 18 years old, you know. But after I got into it I liked it. And even Whitney Young was there. He was right in the line with me. You know?
Did he major in sociology because it was popular too?

Yeah, he was in -- I think he was in sociology. I think so. I'm not sure, because we all stayed in the dormitory, you know. One thing I remember, after I'd been to Englewood High School and had had physics and chemistry and all that, I used to go and help -- excuse me --

Whitney with his physical science. See by that time they'd begun to combine the classes. It was physical science. But when I was going to school you took botany was one course, and zoology was another course, so you were thoroughly educated on it, you know? Whitney and I stayed quite a bit in touch until his death, you know? We felt a little proud of each other after leaving the campus.
You know, we went out and tried to do something about ourselves, you know?
